name: yangi-alifbo
description: Eski o'zbek yozuvini 2026-yilgi yangi lotin alifbosiga o'girish tizimi

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core -w packages/office -w packages/cli -w apps/web -w apps/api -w apps/word-addin -w apps/extension
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit --composite false && tsc -p packages/cli && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p apps/api && tsc -p apps/word-addin && tsc -p apps/extension
